page: Google Cloud Platform c3-highcpu-22 is a compute-focused instance type within the C3 family. It is powered by a dedicated 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8481C processor built on x86_64 architecture, providing 22 vCPUs across 11 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The cache structure features 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 105 MB L3 cache. Memory allocation totals 44.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a 2:1 vCPU-to-memory ratio (2.0 GB per core). This instance does not include integrated GPUs or bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistence.

Benchmark evaluations position the c3-highcpu-22 consistently in the middle tier of comparable cloud server configurations. In raw compute tests, it achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1730.0 and a multi-core score of 12194.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 28645.69. Memory throughput measures at 111.83 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 44.52 GB/sec for writes. The processor includes advanced ISA extensions such as AVX-512 (with VNNI and BF16) and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions for tile and int8 operations). These instructions contribute to strong performance in lightweight inference scenarios, reaching 312.35 tokens per second for text generation on small 135M parameter models.

The 2:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio offers a cost-efficient allocation for CPU-bound tasks where large RAM footprints are unnecessary. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and absence of hardware accelerators limit its viability for I/O-intensive database caching or large-scale deep learning models. Google Cloud Platform c3-highcpu-22 is best suited for compute-intensive batch processing, software compilation, medium-scale web serving, compression jobs, and CPU-based lightweight machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3-highcpu-22 is a compute-oriented virtual machine featuring a dedicated 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8481C processor with 22 vCPUs across 11 physical cores. It provides 44.0 GB of memory, yielding a 2:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The x86_64 processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports specialized instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX for matrix operations. The instance does not bundle local storage or GPUs. Across standard benchmarks, the instance delivers balanced multi-core throughput, including a PassMark CPU score of 28645.69, a multi-core Geekbench score of 12194.0, and 97.1 GB/sec multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, alongside strong small-model LLM generation speeds. Google Cloud Platform c3-highcpu-22 is well fitted for CPU-intensive workloads such as code compilation, CI/CD pipelines, static web serving, and lightweight model inference.
